test: copy in app A, paste in app B through application/x-jasper-clipboard (CLB-002)
contract: Copy/paste crosses separate desktop processes through custom OS format and both menu/paste-event paths.
bug: In-memory clipboard masquerades as system clipboard; menu or native paste drops content/timing.
oracle: Independent destination document text Desktop copy, clip kind text and exact playhead placement; OS bridge observes custom format.
seam: Two real Electron apps and OS clipboard with user copy/menu/keyboard actions.
refactor: Clipboard transport, React layout and command internals may change; pasted document content/media and placement remain stable.
unique: Single browser-window tests share memory or simulated clipboard and cannot prove cross-process OS format interoperability.
reason: Unique OS custom-MIME workflow. Destination document attachment and screenshot make the result inspectable. Destination project is now created per test while Electron processes are reused. This removes document-state order dependence and serial fail-fast skipping without mocking the OS clipboard or changing assertions. Between cases the test saves through Ctrl+S, waits for the public saved state, and uses the Home button for SPA navigation; hard navigation is avoided because the genuine dirty/saving guard correctly refuses it.
validationResult: Integrated Node 20 run passed all 4 clipboard cases (21.8 s); external text and file cases also passed alone (12.2 s and 13.8 s). Initial hard-navigation setup failures were corrected by saving and using Home; no guard bypass.
